newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 7.187 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 7.187 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 91-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 7.187 percent versus 6.723 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 182-day treasury bills was 7.04 percent versus 6.72 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for the NZ$50 million of 343-day treasury bills was 6.952 percent versus 6.802 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
